messages:

Cc: procurement@novumhealth.com
Date: 2025-07-26 08:14 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP — acceptance window shift

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Quick update from our side — after our security gating call this morning, the InfoSec team surfaced two items they need clarified before the acceptance window: 1) data retention and log forwarding (they want retention guarantees and a short-term audit trail sample) and 2) a clarifying statement on how KV cache data is handled when running in Dedicated. Procurement is also asking for a revised SOW that calls out the staged acceptance we discussed.

This means our internal evaluation will be pushed out by ~3 weeks unless we can provide the specific evidence and a narrower acceptance plan (canary test + limited dataset). I understand this impacts your MAP timeline — apologies for the late flag but this is blocking our legal/procurement sign-off.

I've attached the security notes and the procurement RFI for your review. Can we set a short call today to triage?

Thanks,
Katie
Katie Lin
Director, Product Integrations
Novum Health

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2025-07-26 09:02 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP — acceptance window shift

Katie — thanks for the heads up and for the notes. Quoting your ask: "data retention guarantees and sample audit trail" + "clarify KV cache handling for Dedicated". We can move fast on both items. Proposed immediate steps: 

1) Evidence packet: SOC2 evidence extract + export of retention policy statement (security will provide within 24 hours).
2) Canary acceptance scope: commit to a 2-week canary on a sanitized dataset limited to 10% of traffic, with real-time audit snapshots sent to Novum's SFTP for cross-validation.
3) Contract path: offer a short pilot addendum (30-day pilot guardrail) while procurement finalizes full SOW. Pilot will include documented rollback and data-deletion checklist.
4) Commercial mitigation: we can offer a one-time credit for delay (propose up to 15% of first-month fees) subject to Sales/RevOps approval.

If this sounds reasonable I propose a 30-minute triage today at 2:00pm PT to align owners and get sign-off on the MAP change. Ben, Marissa, Lauren — can you join?

- Rishi
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Team — following Rishi's notes, legal and I talked through a conservative contingency we can offer to keep the close moving without rewriting the primary SOW today. Key points: 

- Pilot Addendum (attached): 30-day guardrail that limits scope, requires sanitized dataset, and includes an audit snapshot deliverable. This lets Novum validate end-to-end without full onboarding risk.
- Credit schedule (attached): sliding credit up to 15% if evaluation extends beyond the agreed acceptance window and is driven by Novum procurement/security processes.
- DocuSign flow: if Novum agrees to the pilot addendum we can route for immediate signature and spin up the canary within 48 hours.

If procurement pushes for SOW-level language we escalate — ask for procurement exec name so I can loop legal quickly. From a sales perspective, offering the pilot + credit should preserve the MAP rhythm and keep go-live from slipping more than one gating cycle.

Immediate actions (owners + ETA):
- Ben: finalize Pilot_Addendum_v1 and push DocuSign link to Katie by EOD 7/26.
- Rishi: schedule triage with Novum InfoSec + Prod by 2:00pm PT (owner already assigned).
- Lauren: prepare SOC2 extract and the retention statement; deliver by 7/27 10:00am PT.
- Marissa: raise a Sales Exec approval request (up to 15% credit) and add MAP change to the deal timeline in HubSpot (link below).

Risks: if procurement insists on SOW-level modifications we may need CSM/legal to commit extra review cycles (adds ~1 week). Escalation path: Sales VP -> Legal lead -> Customer procurement head.

I'll mark this thread as the canonical MAP adjustment record. Please update the HubSpot deal and attach the final pilot addendum once signed.
